caption:
Even the pain of a thorn is not wasted.

The Prophet ﷺ said that no hardship reaches a Muslim except that Allah expiates some of his sins because of it, even the prick of a thorn. What hurts you today can be wiping away your sins.

Sahih al-Bukhari 5640 · Grade: Sahih

Share this with someone who is going through a hard time right now.
